card.name: Words that start with a negation, like non or un
card.fires_on: Negating word starts such as non, un, uns, de, indef and no, right after a/an/or/and and before the rest of the word. Also the word never before a verb.

modes.label: Non- before a noun or adjective
modes.description: The prefix non begins a compound, often hyphenated, in medical or technical text.
modes.example: for medical or<< non>>medical purposes can result in physical dependence in

modes.label: Other negating prefixes
modes.description: Un, uns, de or indef starts a negated adjective or verb, split from its stem.
modes.example: somewhat hard and<< uns>>ympathetic outlook quite as much

modes.label: The word never
modes.description: Never used as a negating adverb in a reassurance.
modes.example: Calls to ChildLine are free and they'll<< never>> appear on your phone bill.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word stems that continue a negated word, and away from words like silent, wait and equilibrium.
card.plain: It fires on the opening of a word that means not something, such as non-, un- or de-.
